rationale: The cached PDF retrieved under DOI 10.3390/w10030312 is a completely mismatched hydrology paper ('A 60-Minute Design Rainstorm for the Urban Area of Yangpu District, Shanghai, China' by Anqi Wang, Ningling Qu, Yuanfang Chen, Qi Li, and Shenghua Gu, Water 2018, 10, 312), not the cited target study S443 ('Human aspects of water management at impoverished settlements. The case of Doornkop, Soweto' by Ramírez R.R. and Sañudo-Fontaneda L.A.). Because the actual full text of S443 is not present, both verified_publication_year and quant_verdict are set to 'cannot_tell' per strict audit Rule 2.
